enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Remain asleep. Shift legs. Turn to right side. Pull blanket up to chin. Stretch arms. Turn to back. Remain asleep.

Open eyes. Sit up on bed. Swing legs to floor. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto toothbrush. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth with water. Spit into sink. Turn off tap. Pick up towel. Wipe face. Hang towel. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Close refrigerator. Open cupboard. Take out cereal box. Close cupboard. Take out bowl from cabinet. Pour cereal into bowl. Pour milk into bowl. Open drawer. Take spoon. Close drawer. Sit at table. Eat cereal with spoon. Drink milk from bowl. Stand up. Place bowl and spoon in sink. Turn on tap. Rinse bowl and spoon. Turn off tap.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work, checking phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Close wardrobe. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Fasten belt. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Pick up phone from nightstand. Press home button. Unlock phone. Check messages. Check emails. Put phone in pocket. Pick up bag. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk to car. Unlock car door. Open car door. Sit in driver's seat. Close car door. Fasten seatbelt. Insert key into ignition. Turn key to start engine. Adjust rearview mirror. Adjust side mirror. Press gas pedal. Steer car. Stop at traffic light. Press brake pedal. Wait for green light. Press gas pedal. Continue driving. Park car in parking lot. Turn off engine. Unfasten seatbelt. Open car door. Step out. Close car door. Lock car. Walk to hospital entrance.

Enter hospital. Walk to locker room. Change into scrubs. Walk to nurses' station. Pick up clipboard. Review patient charts. Walk to patient room. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Measure blood pressure. Listen to heart with stethoscope. Listen to lungs. Write notes on chart. Walk to next patient. Administer medication. Talk to patient. Walk to nurses' station. Use computer to update records. Talk to colleague. Attend meeting.

Walk to cafeteria. Pick up tray. Walk to food counter. Point to sandwich. Pick up sandwich. Pick up apple. Pick up bottle of water. Walk to cashier. Pay for food. Walk to table. Sit down. Unwrap sandwich. Take bite. Chew. Swallow. Take another bite. Drink water. Eat apple. Wipe mouth with napkin. Stand up. Throw away trash. Return tray. Walk out of cafeteria.

Return to nurses' station. Pick up phone. Answer call. Write message. Walk to supply room. Pick up supplies. Restock cart. Walk to patient room. Assist patient with walking. Check IV drip. Adjust settings. Talk to patient. Walk to reception. Talk to receptionist. Use computer to schedule appointment. Walk to break room. Fill water bottle. Drink water. Walk back to nurses' station. Review lab results. Call doctor.

Walk to car. Unlock car. Open door. Sit in driver's seat. Close door. Fasten seatbelt. Start engine. Drive out of parking lot. Stop at traffic light. Wait. Drive. Turn onto highway. Drive. Exit highway. Drive on local roads. Park car in driveway. Turn off engine. Unfasten seatbelt. Open door. Step out. Close door. Lock car. Walk to front door.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Take off clothes. Step into shower. Turn on shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rinse body. Apply shampoo. Rinse hair. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Wrap towel. Walk to bedroom. Put on t-shirt and sweatpants. Hang towel. Turn off light.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and chicken. Close refrigerator. Chop vegetables and chicken. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Pour oil into pan. Add chicken and vegetables. Stir. Add salt. Turn off stove. Serve onto plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Stand up. Place plate in sink. Rinse plate. Turn off tap.

Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Press power button. Turn on TV. Flip through channels. Stop on news channel. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Watch TV. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out soda. Close refrigerator. Open bottle. Drink soda. Walk back to living room. Sit on sofa. Watch TV. Pick up remote. Turn off TV. Stand up.

Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Open laptop. Press power button. Type password. Open web browser. Check email. Open document. Type report. Save document. Close laptop. Pick up book. Open book. Read pages. Turn page. Close book. Place book on nightstand. Pick up phone. Put down phone. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Turn off tap. Pick up towel. Wipe face. Hang towel. Turn off light. Walk to bedroom. Take off clothes. Put on pajamas. Pull back blanket. Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes.
Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to side. Adjust pillow. Remain asleep. Shift legs. Pull blanket. Turn to other side. Sigh. Remain asleep.
